title: Config
description:
chough configuration. Every key is optional; anything left out takes its
built-in default, and command line flags override anything set here.

In code this doubles as the resolved configuration: `Config::apply`
merges flags into it and the rest of the program reads from the result.

$schema.description:
Location of the JSON Schema for this file, so editors can validate
and complete it. Typically a path to `schema.json` from the chough
repository or the output of `chough --schema`. Ignored by chough.

filename_pattern.description:
Filename for saved screenshots. Must contain `{timestamp}`, which is
replaced by the capture time as `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS`.

font_family.description:
Font for text labels: a family name such as `DejaVu Sans` or a
generic one (`sans-serif`, `serif`, `monospace`). Used when the
system has it; otherwise labels fall back to the bundled DejaVu
Sans.

font_size.description: Size of text labels in logical pixels, at least 4.

palette.description:
Annotation colors: one to eight `#rrggbb` strings, picked by the
number keys `1` to `8` in this order. The default is red, orange,
yellow, green, blue, purple, white, black.

pixelate_block.description:
Side of a pixelate block in physical pixels, at least 2. Blocks grow
with the pixelated area: the size used is the larger of this value
and a twenty-fourth of the area's shorter side, so a wide area gets
proportionally larger blocks. The default is 12.

save_dir.description:
Directory screenshots are written to. A leading `~` expands to the
home directory. When omitted, `$XDG_PICTURES_DIR/Screenshots` is
used (falling back to `~/Pictures/Screenshots`).

targets.description:
Where the PNG goes when `--to` is not given: any non-empty,
duplicate-free combination of `file`, `clipboard`, and `stdout`.
The default is `clipboard` alone; nothing is written to disk unless
`file` is listed here or in `--to`.
